```{r}
#1 .Load the built-in AirPassengers dataset in R.
data("AirPassengers")
```

```{r}
#2. Explore the first five and last five observations of the dataset.
head(AirPassengers, 5)
tail(AirPassengers, 5)

head(data, 5)
tail(data, 5)
```

```{r}
#3. Identify the starting and ending time periods of the dataset. (start, end)
start(AirPassengers)
end(AirPassengers)
```

```{r}
#4. Determine the frequency and time-series characteristics of the dataset. (frequency, class)
frequency(AirPassengers)
class(AirPassengers)
str(AirPassengers)
```

```{r}
#5. Visualize the monthly passenger trend over the entire period. (plot)
plot(AirPassengers,
     main = "Monthly Airline Passenger Trend (1949-1960)",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Number of Passengers",
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
#6. Decompose the time series into trend, seasonal, and random components. (decompose)
decomposed <- decompose(AirPassengers)
decomposed
```

```{r}
#7. Plot the decomposed components to examine the underlying patterns.
plot(decomposed)
```

```{r}
#8. Analyze the autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation of the time series. (acf, pacf)
acf(AirPassengers,
    main = "ACF of AirPassengers")

pacf(AirPassengers,
     main = "PACF of AirPassengers")
```

```{r}
# 9. Fit a SEASONAL ARIMA model on log-transformed data
log_ap <- log(AirPassengers)

if (!requireNamespace("forecast", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("forecast")
library(forecast)

fit <- auto.arima(log_ap, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
fit
```

```{r}
# 10. Model summary & diagnostics
summary(fit)

checkresiduals(fit)
```

```{r}
# 11. Forecast next 12 months
fc <- forecast(fit, h = 12)

# back-transform
fc$mean     <- exp(fc$mean)
fc$lower    <- exp(fc$lower)
fc$upper    <- exp(fc$upper)
fc$x        <- AirPassengers

fc$mean
fc$lower; fc$upper
```

```{r}
# 12. Plot actual vs forecasted values
plot(fc,
     main = "AirPassengers: Actual vs Forecasted Values (Seasonal ARIMA)",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Number of Passengers",
     col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(AirPassengers, col = "blue", lwd = 2)  # ensure actual is blue
grid()
```
